dual: Create one original cute gouache and colored-pencil educational illustration atlas on a landscape 3:2 canvas. Exactly SIX illustrations, arranged in TWO columns and THREE rows of equal cells. Uniform ivory #fff8ee background, no text, no labels, no dividing lines. Every illustration wholly inside central 70% of its cell, generous blank margins. Soft handpainted detail, rounded appetizing forms, tiny friendly smiles for food, warm natural colors, consistent cozy picturebook style. ROW1 LEFT: exactly TWO separate complete ROUND pizzas seen at three-quarter overhead view, each intact and clearly distinct. ROW1 RIGHT: a casual plate holding a few irregular triangular pizza portions, food rather than whole pizzas. ROW2 LEFT: exactly TWO separate complete round celebration cakes, each intact on its own stand, one pink strawberry cake and one chocolate cake. ROW2 RIGHT: plate with a partially eaten slice of sponge cake, loose crumbs and fork, food portion rather than a whole cake. ROW3 LEFT: exactly TWO adorable living hens standing on grass, feathers and little feet, clearly living birds. ROW3 RIGHT: a cream dinner plate with golden cooked chicken breast slices and small herb garnish, clearly cooked meat, NO living bird, no head or feathers, no gore. Subject layout must follow exact row-major order, don't mix neighboring cells. NO captions, no lettering or watermarks.
concepts: Create ONE original educational sprite atlas in warm gouache and colored pencil storybook style, soft ivory paper background #fff8ee, muted terracotta sage lavender and golden colors, gently rounded forms, detailed painterly textures, subtle soft shadows. Not flat vector, not emoji. Exactly TWELVE illustrations in a strict FOUR columns THREE rows equal tile grid on landscape 3:2 canvas. All subjects within central 65 percent of their cell with generous blank margins, no crossing boundaries. NO smiling faces, NO labels, NO letters or numbers, NO watermark, no grid lines. Left to right row by row: 1 information: open reference book with small index cards; 2 advice: two softly painted overlapping conversation bubbles and a small light bulb; 3 homework: cream exercise notebook with pencil and simple ruled strokes; 4 music: elegant wooden violin with a few decorative musical notes; 5 money: stack of sage banknotes with no denominations and gold coins; 6 time: beautiful little brass hourglass with sand; 7 idea: warm glowing light bulb with subtle tiny stars; 8 dream: crescent moon with soft clouds and stars; 9 plan: clipboard with simple tick marks and pencil; 10 news: folded newspaper with blank rectangles and tiny abstract lines, no readable words; 11 work: warm tan leather briefcase; 12 love: soft painted red heart held by two gentle hands. Cohesive cozy vocabulary card illustrations matching handpainted food illustrations in a children's English learning app.
